Subject: Interested in Hosted API evaluation (self-serve signups)

Hi Markus,

We signed up for the Hosted API sandbox yesterday and we ran a couple of quick tests. We're a PLG motion team at LoopCart; I'm leading the integration. Would love a 30–45 minute run-through of the Hosted API: quick account of latency/cost expectations, basic auth/key rotation, and any gotchas for prefix caching when using streaming responses.

We can do:
- Fri 3/15 10:30–11:15 PT
- Mon 3/18 09:00–09:45 PT

Also, is there a short mutual action plan you follow for evals? We may need an NDA before sharing some dataset samples.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Head of Integrations, LoopCart
sofia@loopcart.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.com

Hi Sofia — great to meet you and welcome aboard. Happy to run a focused 45-minute session so we can cover the items you listed and leave time for any sample data questions. Proposed time: Fri 3/15 10:30–11:15 PT. If that works I'll send an invite and a short prep checklist.

Quick notes / what we'll provide before the call:
- Temporary sandbox API key and short instructions (sandbox access link in HubSpot).
- Short mutual action plan (5 bullets) — rolling through authentication, perf/backpressure expectations, prefix caching behavior, debugging traces, and next steps for Dedicated if you need more throughput.
- Fallback plan ("circuit breaker"): if streaming tokens fail for your sample payloads we'll switch to a batched sync route and capture token/latency metrics so you keep testing progress.

Diego — can you enable the sandbox key + grant LoopCart the 7-day eval bucket (email to me when done)? Sean — heads-up for a possible short deep-dive on SDK integration if they request it.

Sofia — attaching the NDA DocuSign (per your note) and a calendar invite. If you prefer a different slot, reply with the one that suits you.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (invitation), sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (PDF stub), loopcart-eval-nda-docusign.pdf (PDF stub)

Markus —

Done: granted LoopCart the 7-day eval bucket and kicked a temporary key (tmp-AB12). I emailed Sofia the activation link; she should see it in 2–5 minutes.

Two ops notes:
- Recommend a 45-minute slot (you picked that) so we can run a short sample with streaming, then reproduce with sync if they hit any rate-limits.
- If they plan to test large prefix caches, enable the "extended-kv" flag on the sandbox (I enabled it for this key).

LGTM.

Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming Fri 3/15 10:30 PT — Hosted API eval + rampcheck

Hi Sofia — confirmed for Fri 3/15 10:30–11:15 PT. Calendar invite is attached. Quick agenda and mutual action plan so we're aligned:

Agenda (45m)
- 5m intros and success criteria
- 15m live walk-through: create request, streaming vs sync, auth flow
- 10m hands-on: LoopCart runs 2 short payloads (we'll watch traces)
- 10m toggles & fallback: circuit-breaker demo (switch to batched path),KV cache notes
- 5m next steps & optional Dedicated capacity discussion

Mutual action plan (pre-call)
- LoopCart: sign NDA (attached) and confirm which dataset you'll run on the call.
- Redwood: provide temporary sandbox API key and instructions (done — activation link: https://app.redwood.com/sandbox/activate?token=tmp-AB12).
- Both: confirm test payloads in the thread by EOD Thu so we can pre-warm where helpful.

If you want the session shorter, we can compress to 30 minutes focusing only on streaming basics + immediate next steps. Otherwise we'll follow the above.

DocuSign link (NDA): https://docusign.com/nda/LC-118 (attached as PDF stub).

See you Fri — feel free to ping if anything changes.

Best,
Markus
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

One ask: can you include a quick note in the invite about who to contact if we hit a capacity-related error during the call? We'd like an on-call contact (email or Zoom breakout) to avoid delays.

— Sofia
